description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC controller, 'CustomProductGroupsController', that manages custom product groups within an admin interface. It provides endpoints for listing, creating, updating, and deleting product groups, as well as managing products associated with these groups. The class handles HTTP requests, interacts with service classes for business logic, and prepares data for views or JSON responses.

classes.name: CustomProductGroupsController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller for managing custom product groups in the admin panel. Handles HTTP requests for listing, creating, editing, activating/deactivating, and deleting product groups, as well as managing the products within those groups.

methods.name: displayProductGroups
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the main product groups page, initializing a new group.

methods.name: pageCustomGroups
methods.description: Handles POST request to fetch paginated list of product groups as JSON, excluding featured items.

methods.name: saveCustomProductGroup
methods.description: Handles POST request to save a new product group, ensuring the code is provided and not duplicated.

methods.name: removeCustomProductGroup
methods.description: Handles POST request to delete a product group by code.

methods.name: activateProductGroup
methods.description: Handles POST request to update the active status of a product group based on user input.

methods.name: displayCustomProductGroup
methods.description: Handles GET request to display details and categories for a specific product group for editing.

methods.name: pageProducts
methods.description: Handles POST request to list products associated with a group in paginated JSON format.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Handles POST request to add a product to a group.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Handles POST request to remove a product from a group.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Helper method to set up the menu context for view rendering.
